## Brine Dragon, Old (CR 14)

**XP** 38,400  
 LN Huge dragon (water)  
 **Init** +3; **Senses** dragon senses; Perception +25  
**Aura** frightful presence (240 ft., DC 23)  

**Defense**

 **AC** 31, touch 7, flat-footed 31 (-1 Dex, +24 natural, -2 size)  
 **hp** 306 (18d12+90)  
 **Fort** +16, **Ref** +12, **Will** +15  
 **DR** 10/magic; **Immune** acid, paralysis, sleep; **SR** 25  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 60 ft., fly 200 ft. (poor), swim 60 ft.  
 **Melee** bite +29 (2d8+18), 2 claws +28 (2d6+12), tail slap +23 (2d6+18), 2 wings +23 (1d8+6)  
 **Space** 15 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft. (15 ft. with bite)  
**Special Attacks** breath weapon (100-ft. line, 16d6 acid, DC 24), capsize, crush (2d8+18, DC 24)  

 **Spell-like Abilities** (CL 18th; concentration +22)  

 At will—*[control water](../../magic/spells/control-water.md)*, *[obscuring mist](../../magic/spells/obscuring-mist.md)*, *[speak with animals](../../magic/spells/speak-with-animals.md)* (fish only), *[water breathing](../../magic/spells/water-breathing.md)*

 **Spells Known** (CL 11th; concentration +15)  

 5th (4/day)—*[teleport](../../magic/spells/teleport.md)*, *[wall of force](../../magic/spells/wall-of-force.md)*  
4th (7/day)—*[ball lightning](../../magic/spells/ball-lightning.md)** (DC 18), *[ice storm](../../magic/spells/ice-storm.md)*, *[greater invisibility](../../magic/spells/invisibility-greater.md)*  
3rd (7/day)—*[aqueous orb](../../magic/spells/aqueous-orb.md)** (DC 17), *[deep slumber](../../magic/spells/deep-slumber.md)* (DC 17), *[dispel magic](../../magic/spells/dispel-magic.md)*, *[sleet storm](../../magic/spells/sleet-storm.md)* (DC 17)  
2nd (7/day)—*[alter self](../../magic/spells/alter-self.md)*, *[detect thoughts](../../magic/spells/detect-thoughts.md)*, *[invisibility](../../magic/spells/invisibility.md)*, *[make whole](../../magic/spells/make-whole.md)*, *[slipstream](../../magic/spells/slipstream.md)**  
1st (7/day)—*[color spray](../../magic/spells/color-spray.md)* (DC 15), *[feather fall](../../magic/spells/feather-fall.md)*, *[flare burst](../../magic/spells/flare-burst.md)** (DC 15), *[ray of enfeeblement](../../magic/spells/ray-of-enfeeblement.md)*, *[touch of the sea](../../magic/spells/touch-of-the-sea.md)**  
0 (at will)—*[arcane mark](../../magic/spells/arcane-mark.md)*, *[detect magic](../../magic/spells/detect-magic.md)*, *[detect poison](../../magic/spells/detect-poison.md)*, *[mage hand](../../magic/spells/mage-hand.md)*, *[message](../../magic/spells/message.md)*, *[open/close](../../magic/spells/open-close.md)*, *[prestidigitation](../../magic/spells/prestidigitation.md)*, *[read magic](../../magic/spells/read-magic.md)*, *[resistance](../../magic/spells/resistance.md)*  

 ** – denotes spell from Advanced Player’s Guide.*

**Statistics**

 **Str** 34, **Dex** 9, **Con** 21, **Int** 21, **Wis** 18, **Cha** 19  
 **Base Atk** +18; **CMB** +32 (+34 bull rush); **CMD** 41 (43 vs. bull rush; 45 vs. trip)  
**Feats** Greater Vital Strike, Hover, Improved Bull Rush, Improved Initiative, Improved Vital Strike, Lightning Reflexes, Skill Focus (Swim), Vital Strike, [Weapon Focus (bite)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (bite).*  
 **Skills** Bluff +25, Diplomacy +25, Fly +12, Heal +25, Knowledge (arcana, geography, nature) +26, Perception +25, Sense Motive +25, Survival +25, Swim +47; **Racial Modifiers** +8 Swim  
 **Languages** Aquan, Common, Draconic, Dwarven, Elven, Halfling  
 **SQ** water breathing  

**Special Abilities**

 **Capsize (Ex)**  An old or older brine dragon can attempt to capsize a boat or ship by ramming it as a charge attack and making a CMB check. The DC of this check is 25 or the result of the boat captain’s Profession (sailor) check, whichever is higher. For each size category larger the ship is than the brine dragon’s size, the dragon takes a cumulative –10 penalty on the check.

  

**Ecology**

**Environment** any aquatic (Plane of Water)  
 **Organization** solitary  
 **Treasure** triple
